151.translation: 我總能知道鄰居在不在家，因為他們喜歡把音樂開到最大聲。
skeleton: I can always tell if the neighbors are home｜主句
because they like to blast their music｜原因
at full volume｜音量
grammar: tell if + 子句＝判斷是否……。
like to + V＝喜歡做……。
blast music＝把音樂放得很大聲。
at full volume＝以最大音量。

example.en: The neighbors were playing music at full volume.
example.zh: 鄰居把音樂開到最大聲。

152.translation: 各位先生女士，今晚我們為大家安排了一個非常特別的節目，從下一位表演者開始。
skeleton: Ladies and gentlemen｜稱呼
we have a very special program for you tonight｜主句
starting with the next performer｜補充說明
grammar: have a program for + 人＝為某人安排節目。
starting with... 是現在分詞片語，表示「從……開始」。
program 在此指節目／表演安排。

example.en: Tonight's program starts with a musical performance.
example.zh: 今晚的節目從音樂表演開始。

153.translation: Richard 從隔壁房間聽見了他哥哥那 unmistakable、絕不會認錯的聲音。
skeleton: From the next room｜地點
Richard heard｜主句
the unmistakable sound of his brother’s voice｜受詞
grammar: unmistakable＝非常明顯、絕不會認錯的。
sound of + 名詞＝……的聲音。
hear + 名詞＝聽見……。

vocab.usage: unmistakable voice/sign＝辨識度極高的聲音／跡象
recognize someone’s voice＝認出某人聲音

collocations: unmistakable voice＝辨識度極高的聲音
hear the sound of＝聽見……的聲音

example.en: Her voice was unmistakable even over the phone.
example.zh: 即使透過電話，她的聲音也絕不會認錯。

154.translation: 業績獎金可能介於你底薪的 5% 到 15% 之間。
skeleton: The sales performance bonus｜主詞
could be anywhere from 5 to 15 percent｜範圍
of your base pay｜基準
grammar: anywhere from A to B＝從 A 到 B 之間的任何範圍。
could be 表示可能是。
percent of + 名詞＝……的百分比。

vocab.usage: percentage of base pay＝底薪的百分比

options.label: B
options.usage: anywhere from A to B＝介於A到B

collocations: anywhere from A to B＝介於A到B

example.en: The bonus can range anywhere from 5 to 15 percent of base pay.
example.zh: 獎金可能介於底薪的5%到15%。

155.translation: 我不確定演唱會真正取消的原因，但有傳聞說歌手要結婚了。
skeleton: I’m not sure why the concert was really cancelled｜主句
but there’s a rumor｜轉折
the singer is getting married｜傳聞內容
grammar: be not sure why + 子句＝不確定為什麼……。
there is a rumor (that) + 子句＝有傳聞說……。
get married＝結婚。

vocab.usage: spread/hear a rumor＝散播／聽到謠言

collocations: there’s a rumor that...＝有傳聞說……

example.en: There is a rumor that the company will be sold.
example.zh: 有傳聞說這家公司將被出售。

156.translation: Brandon 使用太多當地口語，所以大多數時候我都聽不懂他的意思。
skeleton: Brandon uses so many local colloquialisms｜原因背景
that I don't understand｜so...that 結果
what he means most of the time｜名詞子句
grammar: so many + 複數名詞 + that...＝如此多……以至於……。
what he means 是間接問句／名詞子句。
mean＝意思是、意指。

vocab.usage: works most of the time＝大多時候有效

options.label: C
options.usage: What does it mean?＝這是什麼意思？

example.en: I don't always understand what he means.
example.zh: 我不一定總能理解他的意思。

157.translation: 公司總裁以回顧本年度的重要亮點作為演講開場。
skeleton: The president of the company｜主詞
began his talk with｜動詞片語
a recap of the year’s highlights｜內容
grammar: begin A with B＝以 B 開始 A。
a recap of + N＝……的回顧摘要。
highlight＝最精彩／最重要的部分。

options.label: B
options.usage: a wedge of cheese＝一塊楔形起司

collocations: begin a talk with＝以……開始演講

example.en: The report provides a recap of the year's highlights.
example.zh: 這份報告回顧了本年度的重要亮點。

158.translation: 若不是飯店禮賓人員對細節的注意，這則訊息可能就被忽略了。
skeleton: The message might have gone unnoticed｜主句
if it weren’t for｜反事實條件
the hotel concierge’s attention to detail｜原因
grammar: might have + p.p.＝過去可能已經……。
if it weren’t for + N＝若不是……。
attention to detail＝對細節的注意，是固定搭配。

vocab.usage: strong attention to detail＝非常注重細節

example.en: Her attention to detail prevented a costly mistake.
example.zh: 她對細節的注意避免了一個昂貴的錯誤。

159.translation: 會議主辦單位可透過電子郵件聯絡，以回答任何額外問題。
skeleton: The conference organizers｜主詞
are available by e-mail｜可透過電子郵件聯絡
to answer any additional questions｜目的
grammar: be available by e-mail＝可透過電子郵件聯絡。
to answer... 是目的不定詞。
additional + 複數名詞＝額外的……。

vocab.usage: be available by email＝可透過郵件聯絡

options.label: A
options.usage: be available by email＝可透過郵件聯絡

collocations: be available by e-mail＝可透過郵件聯絡

example.en: Our support team is available by email to answer questions.
example.zh: 我們的支援團隊可透過電子郵件回答問題。

160.translation: 今年全公司的年度訓練課程將於 1 月 5 日至 10 日舉行。
skeleton: The annual company-wide training session｜主詞
will take place｜未來式
January 5-10 this year｜時間
grammar: training session＝訓練課程／場次。
take place＝舉行、發生。
annual 和 company-wide 都作形容詞修飾 session。

vocab.usage: take place in January＝於一月舉行

example.en: The training session will take place next Monday.
example.zh: 訓練課程將於下週一舉行。

161.translation: 在許多亞洲文化中，會議上在對方尚未說完重點前打斷他，被視為不禮貌。
skeleton: In many Asian cultures｜背景
it is considered impolite｜形式主詞被動
to interrupt someone at a meeting｜真正主詞
before they have finished making their point｜時間
grammar: It is considered + adj. + to + V＝做……被認為是……的。
interrupt + 人＝打斷某人。
finish + V-ing＝完成做……。
make one’s point＝把重點說完／表達觀點。

vocab.usage: be considered impolite＝被認為不禮貌
finish making one’s point＝說完重點

collocations: be considered impolite＝被認為不禮貌

example.en: Try not to interrupt people while they are speaking.
example.zh: 別人在說話時盡量不要打斷。

162.translation: 如果你想要，就最好現在決定，因為只剩幾個了。
skeleton: You’d better decide now｜主句
if you want them｜條件
there are only a few left｜剩餘數量
grammar: had better + 原形動詞＝最好……。
a few＝幾個、一些，表示仍有少量。
few＝幾乎沒有，語氣偏否定。
left 是過去分詞形容詞＝剩下的。

vocab.usage: only a few left＝只剩幾個

example.en: Hurry—there are only a few tickets left.
example.zh: 快點，只剩幾張票了。

163.translation: 我知道這不關我的事，但你和 Justin 到底發生了什麼？
skeleton: I know it’s none of my business｜主句
but what exactly happened｜問句
with you and Justin｜對象
grammar: none of my business＝不關我的事，是固定片語。
what happened with...?＝……發生了什麼？
exactly 加強疑問＝到底、究竟。

vocab.usage: It’s none of my business.＝這不關我的事
What exactly happened?＝到底發生什麼？

options.label: A
options.usage: not of my business 不自然

options.label: D
options.usage: none of my business＝不關我的事

collocations: none of my business＝不關我的事
what exactly happened＝到底發生什麼

example.en: It's none of my business, but are you okay?
example.zh: 這不關我的事，不過你還好嗎？

164.translation: 是只有我這樣覺得，還是我每次把視線移開時，收件匣裡的東西都變得更多？
skeleton: Is it just me｜疑問
or is my inbox pile growing｜倒裝問句
every time I look away｜時間
grammar: Is it just me or...?＝是只有我覺得……還是……？
every time + 子句＝每次……。
look away＝把視線移開。
be growing 是現在進行式。

vocab.usage: a pile of work＝一堆工作

example.en: Every time I look away, more emails arrive.
example.zh: 我每次移開視線，都有更多郵件進來。

165.translation: 這家公司建立了一個大型資料庫，收錄潛在新客戶。
skeleton: The firm compiled a large database｜主句
of potential new clients｜資料庫內容
in preparation for ...｜原題後段不完整
grammar: potential + 名詞＝潛在的……。
compile a database＝彙整／建立資料庫。
in preparation for + N＝為……做準備。
原題結尾 in preparation for. 不完整，顯示來源排版可能遺漏文字。

vocab.usage: compile a database/report＝建立資料庫／編製報告
database of potential clients＝潛在客戶資料庫

options.label: B
options.usage: for the next fiscal year＝為下一會計年度

collocations: compile a database＝建立／彙整資料庫

example.en: The firm compiled a database of potential clients.
example.zh: 公司建立了一份潛在客戶資料庫。

165.sourceNote: 原題尾端「in preparation for.」明顯不完整，且選項 B 似乎可能是遺失的句尾文字；本題 D potential 仍可由 potential new clients 明確判斷。

166.translation: 他人很好，而且再說，給他一次機會也沒有壞處。
skeleton: He’s a great guy｜主句一
and besides｜補充語
there is no harm in giving him a chance｜主句二
grammar: besides 作副詞＝此外、再說。
There is no harm in + V-ing＝做……沒有壞處。
give someone a chance＝給某人機會。

vocab.usage: There is no harm in＝……沒有壞處

options.label: D
options.usage: fall by the wayside＝半途而廢

collocations: There is no harm in + V-ing＝做……沒有壞處
give someone a chance＝給某人機會

example.en: There is no harm in asking for more information.
example.zh: 多問一些資訊也沒有壞處。

167.translation: 我看到你躲在那裡了，小伙子！現在立刻出來。
skeleton: I see you hiding there｜主句
young man｜稱呼
Please come out this instant｜命令／請求
grammar: see + 人 + V-ing＝看到某人正在做……。
this instant＝立刻、現在，是強調性片語。
come out＝出來。
collocations: see someone + V-ing＝看到某人正在做

example.en: Come here this instant.
example.zh: 現在立刻過來。

168.translation: 由於缺乏具體且有說服力的證據，警方目前只能得出推測性的結論。
skeleton: Due to a lack of concrete and convincing evidence｜原因
the police have only reached｜主句
speculative conclusions｜受詞
grammar: due to + N＝由於……。
a lack of + N＝缺乏……。
evidence 通常是不可數名詞。
reach a conclusion＝得出結論。
collocations: a lack of evidence＝缺乏證據

example.en: There was not enough evidence to reach a conclusion.
example.zh: 沒有足夠證據可以得出結論。

169.translation: 這間錄音室的新錄音軟體非常先進，能夠執行大量功能。
skeleton: The studio's new recording software｜主詞
is state-of-the-art｜補語
and is capable of performing｜並列補語
a multitude of functions｜受詞
grammar: state-of-the-art＝最先進的。
be capable of + N／V-ing＝有能力做……。
a multitude of + 複數名詞＝大量的……。

vocab.usage: a multitude of functions＝大量功能

options.label: B
options.usage: be capable of + V-ing＝有能力做

collocations: be capable of + V-ing＝有能力做

example.en: The system is capable of handling thousands of requests.
example.zh: 這套系統能處理數千個請求。

170.translation: Valerie 多年來一直都有穩定優異的表現，因此我們推薦她升遷。
skeleton: Valerie has been a consistent performer for years｜現在完成式
so we are recommending her｜結果
for a promotion｜目的
grammar: consistent performer＝表現穩定的人。
has been + 名詞／形容詞 表示從過去持續至今。
recommend + 人 + for + 名詞＝推薦某人獲得……。

vocab.usage: recommend someone for a promotion＝推薦某人升遷

collocations: recommend someone for a promotion＝推薦某人升遷

example.en: She has been a consistent performer and deserves a promotion.
example.zh: 她表現一直很穩定，值得升遷。

171.translation: 清楚的職務說明有助於招募合適的人，之後也能用來追蹤他的工作進展。
skeleton: A clear job description｜主詞
helps to recruit the right person｜作用一
and then monitor his or her progress｜作用二
grammar: job description＝職務說明，是固定搭配。
help to + V＝有助於做……。
recruit 與 monitor 由 and 平行連接。
空格前有形容詞 job，後需要名詞 description。

vocab.usage: write/review a job description＝撰寫／審閱職務說明

collocations: recruit the right person＝招募合適的人

example.en: The job description lists the main responsibilities.
example.zh: 職務說明列出主要工作責任。

172.translation: Tom 滑倒摔跤時，腳踝受到輕微傷勢。
skeleton: Tom received a minor injury to his ankle｜主句
when he slipped and fell｜時間
grammar: minor injury＝輕傷，是固定搭配。
injury to + 身體部位＝某部位受傷。
slip and fall＝滑倒摔跤。

options.label: D
options.usage: in a professional manner＝以專業方式

collocations: injury to the ankle＝腳踝受傷

example.en: He suffered a minor injury to his ankle.
example.zh: 他的腳踝受到輕傷。

173.translation: 法官宣布休庭兩小時，讓陪審團討論證據。
skeleton: The judge called a 2-hour break｜主句
to allow the jury｜目的
to discuss the evidence｜allow 的補語
grammar: call a break＝宣布休息／休庭。
2-hour 作複合形容詞時 hour 用單數。
allow + 人 + to + V＝允許某人做。
jury＝陪審團。

options.label: C
options.usage: take/call a break＝休息／宣布休息

example.en: The chair called a short break before the next session.
example.zh: 主席在下一場次前宣布短暫休息。

174.translation: Christine 向來不習慣早起，因此她不得不大幅調整作息。
skeleton: Never one for early mornings｜慣用插入片語
Christine had to adjust her schedule drastically｜主句
grammar: Never one for + N＝一向不喜歡／不擅長……的人。
have to + V 的過去式為 had to。
drastically 是副詞，修飾 adjust。

vocab.usage: not one for early mornings＝不習慣早起

options.label: A
options.usage: never one for + N＝向來不喜歡……

options.label: C
options.usage: not even one person＝連一人都沒有

example.en: Never one for early mornings, he struggled with the new schedule.
example.zh: 他向來不習慣早起，因此很難適應新作息。

175.translation: 我不希望事情有任何其他方式；我就喜歡現在這樣。
skeleton: I wouldn’t have it｜主句
any other way｜受詞補充
grammar: I wouldn’t have it any other way＝我就喜歡這樣／不希望有其他方式，是固定表達。
way＝方式，在此與 have it 構成慣用句。

vocab.usage: wouldn’t have it any other way＝就喜歡這樣

collocations: wouldn’t have it any other way＝就喜歡這樣
any other way＝任何其他方式

example.en: The work is challenging, but I wouldn’t have it any other way.
example.zh: 工作很有挑戰性，但我就喜歡這樣。

176.translation: Jean 的手機在包包裡震動，她想起姑媽一直想和她取得聯絡。
skeleton: Jean’s mobile buzzed in her purse｜主句一
and she remembered｜主句二
her aunt was trying to get in touch with her｜受詞子句
grammar: get in touch with + 人＝與某人取得聯絡。
try to + V＝試著做。
remember + 子句＝想起／記得……。

options.label: B
options.usage: put on a show＝舉辦表演

collocations: get in touch with＝與……取得聯絡

example.en: Please get in touch with me when you arrive.
example.zh: 你抵達後請跟我聯絡。

177.translation: 15 日的經濟艙已經完全售罄。你有其他旅行日期嗎？
skeleton: Economy class｜主詞
is completely sold out｜被動／形容狀態
for the 15th｜日期
Do you have an alternate travel date?｜問句
grammar: be sold out＝售罄。
completely 修飾 sold out，表示完全售罄。
alternate + 名詞＝替代的……。
collocations: alternate travel date＝替代旅行日期

example.en: All seats on the evening flight are sold out.
example.zh: 晚班航班的座位已全部售罄。

178.translation: 不管是誰把廚房弄得一團糟，請立刻清理乾淨。
skeleton: Whoever left the huge mess in the kitchen｜主詞子句
please clean it immediately｜祈使句
grammar: Whoever + 子句＝任何……的人／不管是誰。
Whoever left... 整個子句作語意上的對象。
leave a mess＝留下爛攤子／弄得很亂。

vocab.usage: make/leave a mess＝弄亂／留下爛攤子

example.en: Whoever used the meeting room should clean it.
example.zh: 使用會議室的人應該把它清理乾淨。

179.translation: 請不要假裝你理解我正在經歷的事情。
skeleton: Please don’t pretend｜祈使句
that you understand｜受詞子句
what I am going through｜名詞子句
grammar: pretend that + 子句＝假裝……。
go through + 事情＝經歷……。
what I am going through 是名詞子句，作 understand 的受詞。

vocab.usage: go through a difficult time＝經歷艱難時期

options.label: B
options.usage: under the pretense of＝以……為藉口

example.en: Don't pretend that everything is fine.
example.zh: 不要假裝一切都沒事。

180.translation: 航空公司人員宣布，大家該登機了。
skeleton: The airline staff announced｜主句
that it was time｜受詞子句
for everyone to board the plane｜真正內容
grammar: It is time for + 人 + to + V＝某人該做……了。
board + 交通工具＝登上……，不需要介系詞。
staff 可作集合名詞。

vocab.usage: airline staff announced＝航空人員宣布

collocations: It is time for A to + V＝A該做……了

example.en: Passengers may now board the plane.
example.zh: 旅客現在可以登機了。

181.translation: 每當 Jill 對某件事感到焦慮時，她的丈夫總會安慰她、讓她放心。
skeleton: When Jill feels anxious about something｜時間
her husband always reassures her｜主句
grammar: feel anxious about + N＝對……感到焦慮。
reassure + 人＝使某人安心、再次保證。
always 放在一般動詞前。

example.en: The doctor reassured her that the test was routine.
example.zh: 醫師向她保證這只是例行檢查，讓她安心。

182.translation: 我是 Keith Murray。可以請你幫我轉接 Ron Isley 嗎？
skeleton: This is Keith Murray calling｜電話開場
Could you put me through｜禮貌請求
to Ron Isley｜轉接對象
grammar: put A through to B＝把 A 的電話轉接給 B。
Could you + V＝可以請你……嗎？
This is X calling＝我是 X（電話用語）。

vocab.usage: put me through to＝幫我轉接給
This is X calling.＝我是X（電話）

options.label: D
options.usage: put me through to＝幫我轉接

collocations: put A through to B＝把A轉接給B

example.en: Could you put me through to the sales department?
example.zh: 可以幫我轉接業務部嗎？

183.translation: 由於我們的主管出差，Pete 已同意主持本週的會議。
skeleton: Pete has agreed to chair this week’s meeting｜主句
as our director is away on business｜原因
grammar: agree to + V＝同意做……。
chair 在此作動詞＝主持會議。
be away on business＝出差不在。

options.label: B
options.usage: seat the guests＝安排賓客就座

example.en: She agreed to chair the meeting in the director's absence.
example.zh: 她同意在主管不在時主持會議。

184.translation: 對 Lucy 生氣也沒有用，她並不是故意無禮的。
skeleton: There’s no point in getting mad at Lucy｜主句
She didn’t mean to be rude｜原因
grammar: There is no point in + V-ing＝做……沒有意義／沒用。
get mad at + 人＝對某人生氣。
mean to + V＝有意做……。

vocab.usage: There is no point in＝……沒有用

collocations: There is no point in + V-ing＝做……沒用

example.en: There's no point in arguing about it now.
example.zh: 現在為這件事爭論也沒有用。

185.translation: 這家餐廳的食物不太好吃，而且價格還過高。
skeleton: The food at this restaurant is not very good｜主句一
It’s also overpriced｜主句二
grammar: overpriced＝定價過高的、太貴的。
also 通常放在 be 動詞之後。
over- 前綴可表示「過度」。

example.en: The hotel was comfortable but seriously overpriced.
example.zh: 這間飯店很舒適，但價格實在太高。

186.translation: 這兩項產品非常相似，它們之間的差異幾乎微不足道。
skeleton: These two products are so similar｜主句前半
that the difference between them｜so...that 結果主詞
is almost insignificant｜補語
grammar: so + 形容詞 + that + 子句＝如此……以至於……。
difference between A and B＝A與B的差異。
insignificant＝不重要的、微不足道的。

example.en: The difference in price is almost insignificant.
example.zh: 價格差異幾乎微不足道。

187.translation: 許多大型國際機場至少提供三種交通方式前往最近的大城市。
skeleton: Many major international airports｜主詞
offer at least three kinds of transport｜動詞＋受詞
into the nearest large city｜目的地
grammar: nearest 是 near 的最高級＝最近的。
at least＝至少。
three kinds of + 名詞＝三種……。

options.label: A
options.usage: the easiest way＝最容易的方法

example.en: The airport offers several ways to reach the nearest city.
example.zh: 機場提供數種方式前往最近的城市。

188.translation: 真是一場刺激的比賽！冰球幾乎沒有停過，兩隊在冰面上飛速競賽，形成這場難以置信的對決。
skeleton: The puck has barely stopped moving｜背景
as both teams race across the ice｜同時動作
in this unbelievable showdown｜情境
grammar: race 在此作動詞＝快速競賽、疾馳。
as 可表示「當……的同時」。
barely＝幾乎不。
across the ice＝橫越冰面。

options.label: B
options.usage: stroll through the park＝漫步公園

example.en: The players raced across the field.
example.zh: 球員們在球場上飛速奔跑。

189.translation: 起初 Leigh 對住在這麼大的城市感到害怕，但她很快就在那裡有了家的感覺。
skeleton: At first｜起初
Leigh was terrified of living in such a big city｜主句一
but she came to feel at home there rather quickly｜轉折
grammar: be terrified of + N／V-ing＝非常害怕……。
such a + adj. + 單數名詞＝如此……的……。
come to + V＝逐漸開始／最終變得……。
feel at home＝感到自在、像在家。

vocab.usage: make someone feel at home＝讓某人自在

collocations: be terrified of + V-ing＝非常害怕做

example.en: She was terrified of moving abroad at first.
example.zh: 她起初非常害怕搬到國外。

190.translation: 在表演前最後幾天，宣傳人員成功賣掉了每一張可售的票。
skeleton: In the last few days before the performance｜時間
the promoters managed to sell｜主句
every available ticket｜受詞
grammar: manage to + V＝設法成功做到……。
every + 單數可數名詞＝每一個……。
available ticket＝仍可購買的票。

vocab.usage: concert promoter＝演唱會主辦／推廣者

example.en: All available tickets were sold before the event.
example.zh: 活動前所有可售票券都賣完了。

191.translation: 我很感謝你幫我確認這些詞的發音，這樣我就能有自信地發表演講。
skeleton: I would appreciate your help｜主句
with the pronunciation of these terms｜協助內容
so I can deliver my speech confidently｜目的／結果
grammar: would appreciate + 名詞＝會很感謝……。
help with + N＝在……方面的幫助。
deliver a speech＝發表演講。
confidently 是副詞，修飾 deliver。

vocab.usage: deliver a presentation/speech＝發表簡報／演講

example.en: She delivered her presentation confidently.
example.zh: 她很有自信地完成了簡報。

192.translation: 那是你嗎，Ben？你穿著正式西裝，我差點認不出你。
skeleton: Is that you, Ben?｜問句
I almost didn’t recognize you｜主句
in the formal suit you’re wearing｜狀態
grammar: recognize + 人＝認出某人。
almost didn’t＝差點沒有。
you’re wearing 是省略關係代名詞的關係子句，修飾 suit。

vocab.usage: wear a formal suit＝穿正式西裝

example.en: I barely recognized him in his new uniform.
example.zh: 他穿新制服時我幾乎認不出他。

193.translation: 我們從日本來的訪客決定多留幾天。你能幫我把這週剩下時間的行程清空嗎？
skeleton: Our visitors from Japan have decided to stay｜主句一
for a few more days｜期間
Could you help clear my schedule｜請求
for the rest of the week｜時間
grammar: decide to + V＝決定做。
a few more + 複數名詞＝再多幾個……。
clear one’s schedule＝把行程清空／騰出時間。
the rest of + N＝剩下的……。
collocations: a few more days＝再多幾天
the rest of the week＝本週剩下時間

example.en: I cleared my schedule for the rest of the afternoon.
example.zh: 我把下午剩下的行程都清空了。

194.translation: 你邀我吃晚餐很貼心，但我得為明早的簡報休息。改天再約如何？
skeleton: Your offer of dinner is very kind｜主句一
but I need to get rest｜轉折
for the morning presentations｜目的
What about a rain check?｜婉拒並改約
grammar: take/get a rain check＝這次先不參加、改天再約。
need to + V＝需要做。
What about + N?＝……怎麼樣？

vocab.usage: take a rain check＝這次先婉拒，改天再約

options.label: C
options.usage: take a rain check＝改天接受

collocations: take a rain check＝改天再約

example.en: Can I take a rain check on dinner tonight?
example.zh: 今晚的晚餐我可以改天再約嗎？

195.translation: 那名女子的香水味太濃，Aida 等不及電梯門打開。
skeleton: The woman’s perfume was so overpowering｜主句
Aida couldn’t wait｜結果
for the elevator doors to open｜等待內容
grammar: overpowering 形容氣味時＝強烈到令人受不了的。
can’t wait for + N + to + V＝等不及……發生。
so 在此加強形容詞。
collocations: can’t wait for A to + V＝等不及A做

example.en: The perfume had an overpowering scent.
example.zh: 那款香水的氣味非常濃烈。

196.translation: 我們兩個部門應該每月碰面一次，以確保彼此仍然有共識。
skeleton: Our departments should meet once a month｜主句
to be sure｜目的
we're still on the same page｜受詞子句
grammar: once a month＝每月一次。
be on the same page＝有相同理解／共識。
still 表示「仍然」，放在 be 動詞後或一般動詞前。

vocab.usage: make sure everyone is on the same page＝確保大家有共識

options.label: A
options.usage: still on the same page＝仍有共識

example.en: Let's meet regularly to make sure we're on the same page.
example.zh: 我們定期碰面，以確保大家有共識。

197.translation: 我本來可以自己開車載你，但我的車正在修車廠。我幫你叫計程車吧。
skeleton: I would offer to drive you myself｜主句
but my car is at the mechanic’s｜轉折
Let me call you a taxi｜提議
grammar: at the mechanic’s＝在修車師傅的店裡；mechanic’s 後省略 shop/garage。
offer to + V＝主動提出做……。
Let me + V＝讓我來……。

vocab.usage: call you a taxi＝幫你叫車

collocations: call someone a taxi＝幫某人叫車

example.en: My car is at the mechanic's for repairs.
example.zh: 我的車正在修車廠維修。

198.translation: 我寧願晚一點到，也不想冒著拿到超速罰單的風險。
skeleton: I'd rather arrive a bit late｜主句
than risk getting a speeding ticket｜比較
grammar: would rather + V than + V＝寧願……而不……。
risk + V-ing＝冒險做……。
get a speeding ticket＝收到超速罰單。

vocab.usage: get a speeding ticket＝收到超速罰單

collocations: would rather A than B＝寧願A而不B

example.en: I'd rather be late than drive too fast.
example.zh: 我寧願遲到也不想開太快。

199.translation: 我們可以聘一名全職員工，或兩名兼職員工，但很遺憾這就是僅有的選項。
skeleton: We can hire one person full-time or two people part-time｜主句一
but unfortunately｜轉折
those are the only options｜主句二
grammar: either 概念可由 A or B 直接表達。
full-time / part-time 可作副詞，表示全職／兼職地工作。
the only + 複數名詞 options＝僅有的選項。

example.en: Those are the only options available at the moment.
example.zh: 目前只有這些選項可用。

200.translation: 在山區健行時要記得的一件事是，海拔越高，氧氣越少。
skeleton: One thing to remember about hiking in the mountains｜主詞
is that｜連綴
there is less oxygen｜受詞子句
at high altitudes｜地點／高度
grammar: One thing to remember is that...＝要記得的一件事是……。
less + 不可數名詞 oxygen＝較少氧氣。
at high altitudes＝在高海拔處。

example.en: There is less oxygen at high altitudes.
example.zh: 高海拔地區的氧氣較少。
